# ciq-mcp tools

<!-- Generated by `go run ./internal/tools/docsgen`; do not edit. -->

2 tools. Class: **R** read, **W** write, **D** destructive or public. Confirm: `plan` = preview then `plan_id:"<plan_id>"`, `flag` = preview then `confirm:true`, `human` = `confirm:true` plus approval via elicitation, `none` = no gate. ★ marks default toolsets. Schemas are shown with writes enabled.

## core ★

|Tool|Class|Confirm|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|[`auth_status`](#auth_status)|R|none|Report whether developer-portal cookies and the Garmin Connect token are present, their source and expiry. Never returns secrets.|
|[`toolsets`](#toolsets)|R|none|List toolsets, enable or disable them for this session (tool list refreshes), or ask the user to allow Connect IQ writes for this session.|

## Arguments

### auth_status

No arguments.

### toolsets

|Name|Type|Required|Enum|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|`action`|string|yes|`list`, `enable`, `disable`, `enable_writes`|what to do|
|`toolsets`|string[]||`core`, `store`, `sdk`, `simulator`, `connect`|toolsets for enable/disable|
